mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL growth and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE changes and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of observed periods despite the negative signal, or the correlation between RSAFS growth and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past month signals supply-side disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO changes and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is growing at less than 2% annualized, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction term between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL growth is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5 percentage points and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease by more than 100,000 in the past month, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp and PAYEMS decreases > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction term between UNRATE and PAYEMS changes is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of observed periods despite the positive signal, or the correlation between HOUST growth and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) growth is positive and Real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative over the past quarter, it signals a supply-driven economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth > 0% and GDPC1 growth < 0% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction term between INDPRO and GDPC1 growth is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
